layout: Cropped sprite sheets with inspected per-sheet boundaries; scene crops are defined in story-books-v3.js
style: Soft textured 3D storybook art, existing SmartClass mascot reference images, expressive action, no baked-in captions

stories.title: Maya and the Door Beneath the Puddle
scenePrompts: Maya crouches by a puddle on a bright wet garden path; her reflection winks independently.
Close view of a tiny blue fish with red postbag emerging from Maya’s magical puddle.
Maya slides safely down a wide silver water slide through a glowing magical tunnel.
Maya stands on the ceiling inside an upside-down pastel house, astonished at furniture overhead.
Maya tests walking along the ceiling while the blue post-fish floats nearby.
Wide upside-down town with window-swimming fish and potted clouds; Maya touches a tiny raincloud.
A floating yellow boot filled with bread sails past Maya at an upside-down bakery.
Maya and post-fish turn toward a tall distant staircase as clouds tremble at a deep knock.
Maya studies a turquoise river flowing uphill on a broad staircase, leaves floating upward.
Maya sits securely inside a wide green leaf boat beside post-fish at the staircase base.
Leaf boat carries Maya up waterfall stairs past a balcony of bright drying rainbows.
Maya exits leaf boat onto landing facing a tiny round blue door, listening intently.
Maya crouches at a tiny door; an enormous gentle blue eye is visible through the opening.
Tiny blue door opens slightly; a soft blue whale nose gently peeks through while Maya watches.
Maya pulls a golden ribbon, magically widening the circular blue doorway.
Enormous friendly baby blue whale floats through expanded doorway above tiny delighted Maya.
Whale Pip has puffed cheeks and rainbow feather on nose; Maya braces with ribbon.
Whale sneezes sparkling bubbles; pastel houses, leaf boat and potted clouds float gently upward.
Maya rides a floating yellow bread boot holding the post-fish bag beside airborne whale and town.
Whale blows gently as bubble-carried houses and flowerpots settle safely back into place.
Pip holds a flipper beside a large bubble showing Maya’s sunny home garden.
Maya steps from whale flipper through a glowing garden bubble, waving to the post-fish.
Maya returns to original garden puddle; tiny yellow bread boot floats on its surface.
Maya smiles gently at blue whale tail reflected deep in puddle; one tiny sparkling bubble rises.

stories.title: Lily and the Runaway Full Stop
scenePrompts: Lily blue fluffy cloud mascot opens a large picture book showing a red train and black dot.
Small black full stop with two tiny feet jumps off book lettering; Lily looks surprised.
Lily reaches a hand into magical book while red train begins moving inside the illustration.
Lily stands inside a bright illustrated railway station with duck conductor and huge page doorway behind.
Lily boards first carriage while black dot dances on roof of small red engine.
Three ducks board a new yellow carriage beside a pond while Lily counts them.
Wheeled bathtub with rubber duck rolls onto an added carriage; Lily looks amazed.
A floating birthday cake and balloons approach Lily’s train, followed by party furniture.
Birthday party fills three train carriages; Lily catches a balloon while cake wobbles safely.
Long colourful train curves around a rounded hill; Lily sees dot hopping across carriage roofs.
Lily carefully travels through connected carriage interiors past ducks, bathtub and birthday bunting.
Lily notices black dot on hanging book page above a track leading toward an unfinished bridge.
Red train approaches blank white paper gap at book edge; Lily and driver look alert, not terrified.
Lily draws a broad blue crayon curve that becomes a safe new railway track.
Train travels a new looping blue track around the page; ducks cheer and Lily concentrates.
Lily watches rhythmic black-dot hops and holds a small open ticket box.
Black dot lands in ticket box on low carriage roof; Lily gently closes lid.
Lily carries ticket box to engine; duck driver points toward unfinished sentence with clear ending gap.
Lily places black full stop at sentence ending; tiny feet fold away.
Entire train and party settle peacefully; Lily exhales, balloons and cake still.
At station, ducks leave for pond, guests carry cake and wheeled bathtub rolls away.
Lily bows to black dot then steps from giant open book doorway onto home carpet.
Lily on carpet opens book a crack; small duck conductor peeks from between pages.
Peaceful book on carpet with bookmark at station and black dot showing tiny playful toes; Lily laughs.

stories.title: Suzy and the Circus of Giant Shadows
scenePrompts: Orange octopus Suzy holds lantern outside striped circus tent at dusk; shadow has extra waving arms.
Suzy stares curiously as her independent many-armed shadow bows and lifts tent curtain.
Suzy peers under raised circus curtain into golden shadow circus; tiny mouse beside enormous drum silhouette.
Suzy enters circular circus ring with mouse, central lamp, ordinary spoon and button on table.
Mouse holds small spoon before lamp creating gigantic spoon-shaped slide shadow across tent.
Suzy slides down solid magical spoon shadow, tentacles spread playfully, mouse watches.
Suzy experiments moving button near and far from lamp, changing round shadow size.
Button shadow becomes giant round moon above ring; mouse in silver hat looks toward Suzy.
Suzy drums and claps tentacles; huge many-armed shadow band forms behind her.
Mouse tumbles harmlessly into oversized silver hat beside bouncing spoon shadow and moon.
Friendly moths, beetles and crickets arrive with tiny cushions as Suzy opens curtain.
Wide circus ring with insect audience, Suzy and matching shadow bowing under warm golden lights.
Three cricket performers descend giant spoon slide, one safely lands backwards before amused audience.
Mouse pretends to carry giant moon shadow while Suzy carefully positions real button near lamp.
Suzy’s tentacle shadows transform into magnificent arches, wheels and giant flower across circus tent.
First dawn light enters tent and shadow ribbons shrink; Suzy notices with thoughtful surprise.
Suzy shades lamp with tentacles, restoring some shadow size as mouse points toward dawn.
Suzy discovers button creates miniature moon shadow inside her translucent paper lantern.
Mouse and crickets carry tiny circus props toward open lantern held steadily by Suzy.
Close-up glowing paper lantern containing miniature spoon slide, moon and dancing shadow ribbons.
Suzy lifts magical lantern in now sunlit ordinary circus tent; tiny shadow show visible inside.
Suzy walks sunny path holding lantern, her ordinary shadow now mirrors her wave correctly.
Cosy bedroom at evening, lantern beside Suzy’s bed reveals tiny mouse and moon shadow.
Sleepy Suzy tucked in bed giggles at miniature backwards cricket slide glowing inside bedside lantern.

stories.title: Coco and the Twenty-Second Rocket
scenePrompts: Yellow star Coco discovers small round red rocket with blue seat and golden button by garden shed.
Coco points excitedly at pale daytime moon beside rocket with twenty-dot gauge.
Coco buckles blue safety belt inside red rocket cockpit and studies glowing golden button.
Small red rocket launches on silver bubble trail above colourful garden with Coco visible inside.
Red rocket lands securely on broad cloud platform beside tiny weather shed; Coco steps out.
Coco meets friendly tiny cloud keeper among rain jars and receives a jar of sparkling wind.
Coco pours sparkling wind from jar into rocket tank, twenty gauge dots glow.
Rocket leaves cloud and passes gently through side of enormous transparent floating bubble.
Inside giant bubble, belted Coco watches map and cushion float around red rocket cockpit.
Silver flying fish with sparkling ribbon tail talks to Coco through rocket window inside bubble.
Coco catches tiny fizz bubbles in jar beside rocket; silver fish circles cheerfully.
Rocket lands on enormous striped hat brim with giant feather, misty sky all around.
Wide reveal of kind sleeping cloud giant wearing striped hat, tiny Coco and rocket on broad brim.
Coco quietly catches a gentle visible puff of giant’s snore in glass jar on hat brim.
Sleeping giant gently straightens hat while Coco braces safely beside rocket and feather.
Red rocket lifts softly from giant’s hat on faint silver trail, Coco waves quietly.
Rocket lands in broad shallow silver moon crater under starry violet sky.
Coco touches moon crater floor with one foot as golden musical ripple spreads, surprised face.
Coco hops among adjacent shallow moon bowls with distinct glowing musical ripples.
Moon craters glow in rhythmic pattern with Coco; distant Earth garden and listening giant below.
Coco performs moon-bowl concert while bubble fish, cloud keeper and giant listen across sky.
Coco beside rocket with glowing musical fuel tank gives moon surface one final gentle tap.
Rocket descends past familiar hat, bubble and cloud toward garden where mascot friends wait.
Coco and Maya beside landed red rocket in twilight garden, moon overhead and tiny musical glow.

stories.title: Juppy and the Footprints That Went Up
scenePrompts: Green frog Juppy compares own foot with giant three-toed muddy footprints beside garden gate.
Juppy with magnifying glass and blue satchel follows tracks to tree and looks upward.
Juppy discovers yellow feather and tiny striped sock on branches beside upward muddy tracks.
Juppy climbs safe broad leafy stair-branch toward small white tooth-shaped object on twig.
Juppy inspects hollow white tooth-like clue under leaves as yellow feathers drift downward.
Juppy at broad treetop branch discovers solid cloud walkway marked by muddy footprints.
Juppy walks across broad safe cloud path with faraway house silhouette ahead.
Juppy listens beside huge cauliflower-shaped cloud, following distant clucking and creaking.
Reveal cosy small wooden house walking on huge yellow chicken feet across clouds, kettle chimney.
Tiny snail wearing one striped sock leans from walking house window to greet Juppy.
Juppy returns tiny striped sock and shows feather; snail cheers from low house window.
Juppy matches white tooth-shaped shard to chipped white doorstep of walking house.
House crouches on cloud with ladder unfolded; Juppy boards through cosy front door.
Juppy and tiny snail in whimsical house kitchen with large rocking chair and round walls.
Juppy and snail inspect gentle crack in round house wall revealing soft yellow down.
Juppy realises house is huge egg as snail opens cupboard containing picnic blanket and whistle.
Juppy and snail move tea things onto broad cloud picnic blanket safely away from egg-house.
Giant fluffy yellow sky chick hatches from round house shell, roof lifting gently; friends watch.
Newly hatched sky chick shakes feathers; egg-house halves form shelter and bowl beside picnic.
Gentle giant chick takes tiny biscuit offered by Juppy while snail offers plate.
Juppy and snail settle securely in feather nest on giant chick’s back with picnic basket.
Giant yellow sky chick flies gently across clouds carrying Juppy and snail toward garden.
Sky chick lands beside original garden gate; Maya greets Juppy and snail in amazement.
Friends picnic under tree shaded by sky chick wing; tiny snail wears matching striped socks.

stories.title: The Friends Who Unzipped the Night
scenePrompts: Five SmartClass mascots at twilight picnic spot a huge golden zipper across violet sky.
Maya gently pulls reachable golden sky zipper from hilltop while friends watch with wonder.
Five friends climb broad folded-cloud staircase through glowing opening in evening sky.
Reveal magical night workshop with star trays, drying clouds, rolled gold sunrise and spectacled moth.
Tiny moth with oversized spectacles shows Suzy rolled golden sunrise carpet in workshop.
Lily and Coco inspect star polishing tray while Juppy discovers basket of damp clouds.
Maya carefully opens corner of layered pink orange gold sunrise carpet lighting her paws.
Suzy accidentally tips small warm glowing sun out of wooden cradle, surprised expression.
Small glowing sun rolls across workshop past cloud cushion as five mascots follow.
Maya watches sun bounce down cloud steps, little sunrise flashes illuminating sleepy rooster far below.
Maya Lily Juppy catch warm sun gently in picnic blanket across broad staircase landing.
Suzy holds cradle steady as friends carefully return sun, Coco folds picnic blanket.
Five friends choose workshop jobs with spectacled moth and tiny clock in background.
Coco polishes stars with cloth, small star reacting playfully while moth arranges tray.
Lily and Juppy hang differently sized clouds on matching clothes pegs as silver drops fall.
Suzy carefully operates golden lift carrying sun securely in cradle, focused expression.
Maya unrolls pink orange gold sunrise across long frame; horizon outside begins glowing.
Juppy passes fluffy clouds through hatch while Lily arranges them in glowing dawn sky.
Coco smilingly puts polished stars on night shelf as moth explains beside dawn hatch.
All five mascots check completed sunrise machinery; sun at top of lift and moth signals readiness.
Workshop opens to spectacular sunrise over rolling hills; five friends watch in awe from threshold.
Sunlit homes, birds and crowing rooster below; five mascots wave from broad cloud staircase.
Friends return to picnic hill as Maya closes sky zipper leaving tiny gold stitch; Suzy checks basket.
Five friends quietly share biscuit on morning picnic hill beneath their smiling cloud, peaceful satisfied faces.
